about: The Postcommunion of the feast of the Most Holy Body of Christ. It asks to be filled eternally with the Godhead, foreshadowed by the temporal reception of Christ's precious Body and Blood.

seg.tr: Grant, we beseech Thee, O Lord, that we may be filled with the everlasting enjoyment of Thy Godhead, which is foreshadowed by the temporal reception of Thy precious Body and Blood, who livest and reignest with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
